thread:
zara: PM ping: can we add a tiny 'cost tilt' sandbox on route/model pages so teams can try shifting traffic to cheaper model variants and see estimated token-level cost + cache-savings before rolling a canary? Need quick feasibility + API sketch.
matt: doable. Inputs we need: per-model/route 1m rollup with token_count, cache_prefix_hits, and a coarse seq_len histogram (4 buckets). Also per-model per-token unit cost table.
john: telemetry note: current sampling for traces is low but we already emit per-route counters. Propose router emit MV per (model,route,env) minute: tokens, cache_hits, seq_bucket_fracs, p50/p95. Keep tenant out to limit cardinality.
zara: UI requirements from PM: instant feedback (<1s ideally), slider to reroute %, toggle prefetch on/off, and an "Explain" that lists top 3 drivers. Also a CTA "apply as canary" that pre-fills rollout.
omer: backend sketch: two-tier approach. Fast path: use latest MV (last 5m) and apply simple math to estimate delta. Slower accurate path: aggregate past N minutes for CI. API: POST /internal/sim/cost_tilt {model,alt_model,route,reroute_pct,window_mins,seq_override?,cache_override?} -> {cost_delta, token_delta, latency_delta, ci_low, ci_high, drivers}. Keep response minimal.
ux-lena: UX: small inline card showing three compact metrics: cost delta, latency change, expected cache savings. Show uncertainty band and small tooltip with assumptions. Presets: "shift 20% to quant-small" etc.
matt: implementation tasks: 1) router MV proto + emitter, 2) MV store (5-15m retention for quick reads), 3) sim service + auth, 4) console widget + safe gating. Estimate: 2 engs 6 weeks for full accuracy; MVP using last-5m MV on demand ~2-3 weeks.
john: cardinality rule: do NOT tag MV by tenant except for a separate coarse tenant metric. Store only model+route+env. For validation keep predicted_vs_actual summaries per model (daily).
omer: security: gate feature behind beta flag and org_admin role. Redact raw tokens for org viewers that don't own the org; show percentages instead.
zara: monitoring + validation: emit sim_requests_total, sim_latency_ms, sim_error_pct. Run daily batch to compute median sim_error over last 24h per model; if >25% alert platform team.
ux-lena: tiny UX ask: include a tiny historical sim_error sparkline on the card so PMs can eyeball reliability. Also add an "Explain" panel that surfaces most sensitive inputs (seq_len, cache_hit, batching).
matt: API example payload/response (draft):
POST /internal/sim/cost_tilt
{model: "rw-13b-quant", alt_model: "rw-13b-8bit", route: "us-east/low-latency", reroute_pct: 30, window_mins: 60, seq_override: [[0,64,0.5],[65,256,0.35],[257,1024,0.1],[1025,8192,0.05]], cache_override: 0.15}
response: {cost_delta: -34.2, token_delta: -120000, ci: [-40.1,-28.0], drivers: ["cache_hit_rate","median_seq_len","per_token_price"]}
zara: rollout plan: alpha to infra + platform, collect sim vs actual for 48h, open to a small set of beta orgs after median_error <25% for 3 days. Add experiment tag for canary runs.
omer: ops note: store only summary validation stats to avoid high-cardinality storage. Use fixed seq buckets to keep proto stable.
john: devops: please post proto PR for MV + sim API so infra can review schema. I'll work on MV emitter once proto is up.
sim-bot: created task COSTTILT-782 assigned to matt/omer. CI job 9921 queued. :gear:
zara: thanks all — can @matt @omer draft the proto + sample response here by EOD? I'll coordinate PM acceptance and beta list. :thumbsup:
